lib/output/render: A project's bundle includes its styles module (`@stamp-paint-styles`), which the style feature writes.
lib/paint/gate: The private gate paints a pack's brushes with their profiles, checked against the medium their style probes in.
lib/paint/studies: A study paints in a style, resolved with its medium and pigments.
lib/paint/document: A document's brushes and paper assets are checked against the styles that serve them.
